description: Explicit capability contracts through which the Atlas discovers and hands off to other Orchid Continuum modules. Declared status uses the Brain capability vocabulary (runtime/brain_capability_registry.py in orchid-calyx-backend). A declaration is not a health check: the backend /atlas/capabilities endpoint adds live probes where it can and reports 'not_probed' otherwise. Handoff context is navigation context only and is never scientific evidence. This file does not create a scheduler; workflows are declarative navigation chains executed by the person using the Atlas. Mirrored verbatim in orchid-calyx-backend/contracts and orchid-continuum-frontend/contracts.

identifier_systems.genus: Accepted Latin genus name, capitalised, single word.
identifier_systems.scientific_name: Accepted binomial or infraspecific name without authorship.
identifier_systems.occurrence_id: Darwin Core occurrenceID as carried by the source record.

capabilities.title: Viewport occurrence query
capabilities.provenance: Owner-approved relation named by ATLAS_OCCURRENCE_RELATION; per-dataset attribution and licence returned with every response.
capabilities.error_behavior: Returns source.state = source_not_configured | unavailable with zero records; never substitutes other data.
capabilities.fallback: Frontend falls back to the canonical atlas_occurrences loader and labels the source accordingly.

capabilities.title: Viewport occurrence summary
capabilities.error_behavior: Empty buckets with source state; never inferred counts.
capabilities.fallback: Frontend computes the same summary from loaded locality-safe records.

capabilities.title: Canonical taxon resolution
capabilities.provenance: public.orchid_taxonomy accepted names; synonymy source not yet available.
capabilities.error_behavior: Reports unresolved or ambiguous rather than guessing.
capabilities.fallback: Atlas keeps the name as navigation text and does not assert a taxon_id.

capabilities.title: Species Dossier
capabilities.provenance: Dossier sections carry EvidenceReceipt provenance and evidence state.
capabilities.error_behavior: 404 for unknown taxon; 503 when the database is unavailable.
capabilities.fallback: Link to species search by name.

capabilities.title: Genus profile / Featured Genus
capabilities.provenance: Genus profile page states its own sources.
capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Vision AI identification
capabilities.provenance: Model output is a candidate, never evidence of occurrence.
capabilities.error_behavior: Provider-gated; unavailable when no provider is admitted.

capabilities.title: Image Intelligence gallery
capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Relationship Matrix
capabilities.provenance: Matrix cells carry their own evidence state.
capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Literature
capabilities.provenance: Citations carry their own source records.
capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Conservation Hub
capabilities.provenance: Assessments cite their assessing body; unresolved is shown as unresolved.
capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Pollination Intelligence

input.pollinator_taxon: route parameter is the pollinator, not the orchid

capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Mycorrhizal associations

input.fungal_taxon: route parameter is the fungus, not the orchid

capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Ask Calyx
capabilities.provenance: Calyx answers cite retrieved evidence; Atlas context is not evidence.

capabilities.title: Research Station
capabilities.error_behavior: Page shows its own unavailable states.

capabilities.title: Orchid Brain knowledge graph
capabilities.provenance: Graph edges carry evidence state and source.
capabilities.error_behavior: Gated by KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_ENABLED in the frontend.
